relationships.subject: Small molecule CGRP receptor antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: Small molecule CGRP receptor antagonists, such as rimegepant and ubrogepant, are effective for the acute treatment of migraine headache.

relationships.subject: CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: monoclonal antibodies against CGRP or the CGRP receptor are beneficial for the prophylactic treatments in chronic migraine

key_findings: Historical review of CGRP biology and the development of gepants and anti-CGRP/receptor antibodies for migraine.
